articles.title: Are Harnesses Worth the Cost?
articles.snippet: Naresh Jain compares coding agents building the same API service with and without a behavioral harness. A frontier model, GPT-6 Sol, passed every external evaluation either way. But a cost-optimized model, GPT-6 Luna, succeeded in only 3 of 10 unharnessed runs and all 10 with the harness. While adding the harness increased token usage and runtime for Luna, the harnessed Luna runs achieved the same 10-for-10 reliability as GPT-6 Sol while costing 33% less per run ($0.273 vs $0.406). articles.snippet: Data contracts are a way to describe the contents and guarantees of datasets. Simon Harrer and Arif Wider describe in detail what they are and how to use them.
